image_description: A night-time urban street scene featuring a brick building facade. Prominently displayed is a rectangular white sign with black, stylized text reading 'NATOIS' (or similar). Above it are two illuminated blue star-shaped decorations and a smaller dark rectangular sign with illegible white text. To the left, a window display shows warm interior lighting and another sign with red text. A small potted plant is visible near the bottom left.
